messages:
alex (FinanceApp): Hey @support — our rerank calls started returning an error this morning. We're hitting this from our prod service in us-west-2, looks like the API is rejecting the model id. Example response below. Can someone help? :confused:

alex (FinanceApp): Response payload: `HTTP 400` 
```
{"error":{"type":"invalid_request","message":"model 'redwood-reranker-v0' is deprecated or not found","code":"model_not_found"}}
```

alex (FinanceApp): We're calling the endpoint `/v1/rerank` with ~200 candidates (usually fine). Request id from our side: `req_0a7b9c3f`. Latency has been normal until the error showed up at 08:12 PST.

tara (support): Thanks Alex — sending to eng-runtime. Do you have the exact model field you used in the request body and a minimal repro (curl) you can paste? Also whether this happens for all requests or only some payloads.

alex (FinanceApp): model string in the body: "model": "redwood-reranker-v0". repro curl below: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-reranker-v0","query":"latest earnings","candidates":["candidate1","candidate2",...],"max_candidates":200}'
```

alex (FinanceApp): It fails consistently for every call I try now. We rolled back nothing. We did rotate keys yesterday but that was only for another service.

jia (eng-runtime): Thanks for the repro. We intentionally deprecated `redwood-reranker-v0` when we pushed the quantized combos. The supported replacement is `redwood-rerank-v1` (note the hyphen/word change). We should've served a clearer error with a suggested model id — looks like the code path returned a generic model_not_found.

jia (eng-runtime): Quick workaround: change the model string to "redwood-rerank-v1". That should accept the same request shape. Can you try and confirm?

alex (FinanceApp): Trying now... ok that fixed it. With `redwood-rerank-v1` the call returns `200` and scores look reasonable. Thanks, but two follow-ups: 1) Why did prod suddenly start rejecting the old id? 2) Can we get a mapping table or deprecation notice earlier? We only saw a brief note in the weekly changelog that we missed.

tara (support): 1) I'll add context: we had a backend rollout that removed the alias mapping for older rerank ids to simplify model selection. That alias removal went out with an infra change at 07:55 PST. 2) We should have sent a targeted deprecation notice — sorry about that. I'll open a channels announcement and email to customers who used `redwood-reranker-v0`.

miguel (eng-sre): Adding some infra notes — the alias/unified-model lookup used to map deprecated ids automatically. During the scale-up to the new sharded cluster we disabled legacy aliasing to reduce routing complexity. That caused direct lookups for deprecated ids to 404/400. The rollout was intentional but we should have kept a soft redirect for a week.

miguel (eng-sre): For telemetry: I see ~1200 failed rerank requests between 07:55-08:30 from several customers. I've started a metric dashboard: `rerank.deprecated_id_errors` and an alert to watch continued failures.

jia (eng-runtime): Short-term fix plan: I'll push a small compatibility shim to accept `redwood-reranker-v0` and map it to `redwood-rerank-v1` for the next 72 hours, giving customers time to migrate. Long-term: we need a deprecation policy page + API warning header when a deprecated model id is used.

tara (support): I'll draft the outbound communication and call out customers using the old id. Alex — do you want us to auto-migrate your account's requests (server-side rewrite) while you update your code? We can do it for one week.

alex (FinanceApp): Yes please — auto-migrate would be great. We'll still change the client but this avoids an outage window for us.

miguel (eng-sre): Agree. Jia, please proceed with shim + hotfix. I'll enable the alert and stitch the logs to the support ticket. Also recommend instrumenting a response header like `X-Model-Deprecation: redwood-reranker-v0->redwood-rerank-v1;expires=2024-11-01` in the future.

jia (eng-runtime): On it. Pushing compatibility shim now. Will post the commit and deploy id.

infra-bot: deploy started by jia — commit `a7d3c9` to service `rerank-router` (canary)

jia (eng-runtime): Deploy canary up. Request id `req_0b8dcb12`. Alex, can you retry against production? It should succeed without changing your client while we keep the shim enabled.

alex (FinanceApp): Retried at 08:47 PST, saw 200s and scores look identical to before. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

tara (support): Marking this thread as resolved on our side once the auto-migration window is set. We'll follow up with a deprecation roadmap and the recommended model id list.

miguel (eng-sre): Follow-ups: 1) create a runbook for alias removal 2) add integration test that fails if deprecated ids are removed without warning 3) attach customers list to the outage ticket.

jia (eng-runtime): Commit `a7d3c9` deployed canary -> promoting to stable. Will keep shim active for 72 hours and then require explicit migration.

alex (FinanceApp): Great. Please cc me on the deprecation notice and the timeline. Appreciate the quick support :thumbsup:
